swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: AP63203WU-7 uses TSOT-23-6 (6-pin, TSOT26) while LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB uses TO-263-5 (5-pin, KTT); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (FB vs VIN), Pin 2 (EN vs SW), Pin 3 (VIN vs GND), Pin 4 (GND vs FB), Pin 5 (SW vs EN), Pin 6 (BOOT vs NONE). Soldering LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB onto a AP63203WU-7 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
Exposed thermal pad/tab mismatch (TSOT-23-6: NONE vs TO-263-5: GND); PCB land pattern & solder-mask change required.
HIGH RECTIFICATION DIFFERENCE: LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB is non-synchronous and requires an external Schottky catch/freewheeling diode, whereas the counterpart integrates a synchronous low-side MOSFET.

HIGH SWITCHING FREQUENCY SHIFT: fsw differs by 86% (AP63203WU-7: 1100 kHz p.5 vs LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB: 150 kHz p.7); re-evaluate inductor core loss, ripple current ΔIL, output capacitor ESR ripple, and EMI harmonics.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (AP63203WU-7: 3.9 µH p.13 vs LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB: 33 µH p.25); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: AP63203WU-7 specifies 2000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1) vs LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB 3000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1). Remember boost Iout,max is strictly less than Isw due to duty-cycle scaling.
CAUTION THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA differs by 44% (AP63203WU-7: 89 °C/W p.4 vs LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB: 50 °C/W p.5); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: AP63203WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) and LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB (Texas Instruments, TO-263-5) are NOT pin-to-pin drop-in compatible (Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (FB vs VIN), Pin 2 (EN vs SW), Pin 3 (VIN vs GND), Pin 4 (GND vs FB), Pin 5 (SW vs EN), Pin 6 (BOOT vs NONE); exposed pad / thermal tab net mismatch. Key datasheet deltas: topology is buck (sync) vs buck (non-sync), switching frequency is 1100 kHz (p.5) vs 150 kHz (p.7), rated current is 2000 mA (p.1) vs 3000 mA (p.1), typical inductor is 3.9 µH (p.13) vs 33 µH (p.25), and Iq is 22 µA (p.5) vs 5000 µA (p.7). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.4), thermal margin (θJA 89 vs 50 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
